transcript.text: Zanussi dishwasher keeps tripping the electrics, not every time though. Usually about 15 mins in. Model ZDT21006FA

⚠ Stop using this appliance
Stop using the appliance, switch it off and unplug it (or isolate it at the consumer unit). Don't keep resetting a trip. Have it checked by a qualified electrician or appliance engineer before using it again.
